title: Data model for a Biocorner supply chain organization
description: CIRCULOOS data model for an organization participating in the Biocorner supply chain, covering its legal identity, contact details and its functional role and tier within the supply chain.

addressLocality.description: The locality in which the street address is. Model:'https://schema.org/addressLocality'

addressRegion.description: The region in which the locality is. Model:'https://schema.org/addressRegion'

id.description: Property. Unique entity identifier, with the format urn:ngsi-ld:Organization:<id>.

type.description: Property. NGSI Entity type. It has to be Organization

name.description: Property. Full official name of the organization as registered in public records, including legal suffix where applicable.

legalForm.description: Property. Legal entity classification (e.g. Limited Liability Company, Research Center, Public University). Relevant for consortium agreements and contractual arrangements.

role.description: Property. Functional role of the organization within the project supply chain (e.g. RTO, Manufacturer, Contract Manufacturer, SRM Supplier).

supplyChainRole.description: Property. High-level classification of the organization function: RTO for research and development, Manufacturer for production, or SRM Supplier for material sourcing.

tier.description: Property. Supply chain tier relative to final product: Tier 0 for entities directly involved in product development or manufacturing, Tier 1 for raw material suppliers.

address.description: Property. Postal address of the organization as a structured object (street, locality, region, country, postal code), following the schema.org PostalAddress format. addressRegion holds the administrative region where the organization is headquartered, used for regional supply chain mapping and geographic analysis.

contactEmail.description: Property. Email address of the organization.

contactPhone.description: Property. Telephone number of the organization.
